questions.question: Name the four Grade 6 History topics and the term in which each is studied.
questions.expected_answer: Term 1 is an African kingdom long ago in southern Africa, Mapungubwe. Term 2 is explorers from Europe find southern Africa. Term 3 is democracy and citizenship. Term 4 is medicine through time.

questions.question: Describe the golden rhinoceros and explain where and when it was found.
questions.expected_answer: The golden rhino is a small figure made of thin sheets of gold pressed around a carved wooden body and held on with tiny gold tacks. The wood has rotted away. It was found in 1933 in a royal grave on top of Mapungubwe Hill, near where the Limpopo and Shashe Rivers meet in Limpopo.

questions.question: Explain how historians know about Mapungubwe if its people left no written records.
questions.expected_answer: They use sources such as objects found by archaeologists, including gold, pottery, beads, tools, animal bones, the remains of houses and walls, and graves. They also use oral history from communities in the region and writings by travellers who visited the East African coast. Secondary sources, such as books by archaeologists, explain these finds.
